gates.title: Install the Slack app in the workspace
gates.detail: Create a Slack app from slack/manifest.json and install it in the workspace where the demos should appear. Approve it if the workspace requires an admin. Skip this when Demo Publisher is already installed there.

gates.title: Store the bot token where Salesforce can use it
gates.detail: Copy the bot token from the install into a Salesforce named credential for https://slack.com/api. Keep the token out of git and out of the demo spec. Skip this when that credential already exists.

gates.title: Allow a Demos section in the sidebar
gates.detail: Shared sidebar sections need a paid Slack plan and permission to create user groups. In workspace permissions, allow user groups to be created. Skip this when @demos already exists and shows as a sidebar section.

gates.title: Connect the Salesforce org to seed
gates.detail: Sign the coding agent into the Salesforce org that should receive the records and the publisher flow. A demo org is the usual choice. The agent uses whichever org that login opens.

gates.title: Deploy the Salesforce flow that posts to Slack
gates.detail: The flow is an after-save flow on Case. It posts salesforce/slack-post.json when a tagged case is created or its status changes. Deploy it with the Salesforce CLI or Metadata API. Skip this when that flow is already active.

gates.title: Create new objects, fields, or Apex yourself
gates.detail: This brief asks for metadata beyond the publisher flow. Add it in Salesforce Setup, or take it out of the flow. The agent creates records on objects the org already has.
